house_style: Soft colored chalk illustration for a Grade 4 classroom chalkboard. Rich powdery strokes, confident simple silhouette, gentle shading, bright chalk highlights, tactile hand drawn texture. A single isolated object, centered with generous padding, square composition, entirely visible. No text, letters, numbers, logos, people or faces. Flat pure magenta (#FF00FF) background for keying.
